proof.python:
import json
import os
import statistics
import tempfile
import time

from progressr.evaluate import with_progress
from progressr.progressor import progressor
from progressr.reporters import handler_ascii_alert


def _fresh(name):
    return os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), name)


def one():
    bare = handler_ascii_alert()
    path = _fresh("alert.txt")
    handle = open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

    def body():
        progress = progressor(steps=4, on_exit=False)
        progress(message="a")
        progress(amount=0, message="zero")
        progress(message="ding", amount=0, type="interrupt", class_="control_progression")
        progress(message="b")
        progress(message="c")
        progress(message="d")

    with_progress(
        body,
        handlers=handler_ascii_alert(file=handle, enable=True, intrusiveness=1),
        enable=True,
        interval=0,
        delay_terminal=False,
        delay_stdout=False,
        delay_conditions=(),
    )
    handle.close()
    return {
        "intrusiveness": bare._env["intrusiveness"],
        "target": list(bare._env["target"]),
        "text": open(path, encoding="utf-8").read(),
    }


value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
value["median_ms"] = statistics.median(elapsed)
print(json.dumps(value))

proof.python:
import contextlib
import io
import json
import re
import statistics
import time

from progressr.evaluate import with_progress
from progressr.progressor import progressor
from progressr.reporters import handler_debug

_LINE = re.compile(
    r"^\[.*?\] \([0-9.]+s => \+[+-]?[0-9.]+s\) ([^:]+): ([0-9.]+)/([0-9.]+) "
    r"\(([+-][^)]*)\) '(.*)' \{clear=([^,]*), enabled=([^,]*), status=(.*)\}"
    r"(?: \[progressor=.*, owner=.*\])?$"
)


def _parse(text):
    events = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        match = _LINE.match(line)
        if match is None:
            raise RuntimeError(line)
        events.append(
            {
                "type": match.group(1),
                "step": float(match.group(2)),
                "max_steps": float(match.group(3)),
                "delta": float(match.group(4)),
                "message": match.group(5),
                "clear": match.group(6),
                "enabled": match.group(7),
                "status": match.group(8),
                "uuid_suffix": " [progressor=" in line,
            }
        )
    return events


def _run(handler, fn):
    err = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
        with_progress(
            fn,
            handlers=handler,
            enable=True,
            interval=0,
            delay_terminal=False,
            delay_stdout=False,
            delay_conditions=(),
        )
    return _parse(err.getvalue())


def one():
    def plain():
        progress = progressor(steps=4, on_exit=False)
        progress(message="one")
        progress(message="two", amount=0, class_="sticky")
        progress(message="halt", amount=0, type="interrupt", class_="control_progression")
        progress(message="three")
        progress(message="four")

    def marked():
        progress = progressor(steps=1, on_exit=False)
        progress(message="z")

    events = _run(handler_debug(enable=True, uuid=False), plain)
    uuid_events = _run(handler_debug(enable=True, uuid=True), marked)
    for item in events:
        item.pop("uuid_suffix")
    suffix = all(item.pop("uuid_suffix") for item in uuid_events)
    return {"events": events, "uuid_events": uuid_events, "uuid_suffix": suffix}


value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
value["median_ms"] = statistics.median(elapsed)
print(json.dumps(value))

.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
library(progressr)
options(progressr.enable = TRUE)

json_str <- function(s) {
  s <- enc2utf8(paste(s, collapse = ""))
  chars <- strsplit(s, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(chars) == 0) return('""')
  parts <- vapply(chars, function(ch) {
    if (ch == '"') return('\\"')
    if (ch == "\\") return("\\\\")
    if (ch == "\n") return("\\n")
    if (ch == "\r") return("\\r")
    if (ch == "\t") return("\\t")
    ch
  }, "")
  paste0('"', paste(parts, collapse = ""), '"')
}
json_bool <- function(x) if (isTRUE(x)) "true" else "false"
json_num <- function(x) sprintf("%.17g", as.numeric(x))

read_all <- function(path) {
  n <- file.info(path)$size
  if (is.na(n) || n == 0) return("")
  readChar(path, n, useBytes = TRUE)
}

one <- function() {
  bare <- handler_filesize(file = tempfile("fsdef"))
  fpath <- tempfile("fs")
  snaps <- with_progress({
    p <- progressor(steps = 4, on_exit = FALSE)
    init <- if (file.exists(fpath)) file.size(fpath) else -1
    p(message = "work")
    first <- read_all(fpath)
    p(amount = 0, message = "hold")
    zero <- read_all(fpath)
    p(message = "broke", amount = 1, type = "interrupt", class = "control_progression")
    interrupt <- read_all(fpath)
    p(message = "go")
    p(message = "go")
    p(message = "go")
    list(init = init, first = first, zero = zero, interrupt = interrupt)
  }, handlers = handler_filesize(file = fpath, enable = TRUE, clear = FALSE, intrusiveness = 0),
     enable = TRUE, interval = 0,
     delay_terminal = FALSE, delay_stdout = FALSE, delay_conditions = character())
  fclear <- tempfile("fsc")
  with_progress({
    p <- progressor(steps = 2, on_exit = FALSE)
    p(message = "x")
    p(message = "y")
  }, handlers = handler_filesize(file = fclear, enable = TRUE, clear = TRUE, intrusiveness = 0),
     enable = TRUE, interval = 0,
     delay_terminal = FALSE, delay_stdout = FALSE, delay_conditions = character())
  fzero <- tempfile("fsz")
  with_progress({
    p <- progressor(steps = 0, on_exit = FALSE)
  }, handlers = handler_filesize(file = fzero, enable = TRUE, clear = FALSE, intrusiveness = 0),
     enable = TRUE, interval = 0,
     delay_terminal = FALSE, delay_stdout = FALSE, delay_conditions = character())
  fdis <- tempfile("fsd")
  with_progress({
    p <- progressor(steps = 2, on_exit = FALSE)
    p(message = "x")
    p(message = "y")
  }, handlers = handler_filesize(file = fdis, enable = FALSE),
     enable = TRUE, interval = 0,
     delay_terminal = FALSE, delay_stdout = FALSE, delay_conditions = character())
  c(
    list(
      intrusiveness = environment(bare)$intrusiveness,
      target = environment(bare)$target,
      final = read_all(fpath),
      final_size = file.size(fpath),
      cleared = file.exists(fclear),
      zero_steps = read_all(fzero),
      zero_size = file.size(fzero),
      disabled = file.exists(fdis)
    ),
    snaps
  )
}

import json
import os
import statistics
import tempfile
import time

from progressr.evaluate import with_progress
from progressr.progressor import progressor
from progressr.reporters import handler_filesize


def _fresh(name):
    return os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), name)


def _read(path):
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        return handle.read()


def _run(handler, fn):
    return with_progress(
        fn,
        handlers=handler,
        enable=True,
        interval=0,
        delay_terminal=False,
        delay_stdout=False,
        delay_conditions=(),
    )


def one():
    bare = handler_filesize(file=_fresh("default.progress"))
    path = _fresh("run.progress")
    box = {}

    def body():
        progress = progressor(steps=4, on_exit=False)
        box["init"] = os.path.getsize(path)
        progress(message="work")
        box["first"] = _read(path)
        progress(amount=0, message="hold")
        box["zero"] = _read(path)
        progress(message="broke", amount=1, type="interrupt", class_="control_progression")
        box["interrupt"] = _read(path)
        progress(message="go")
        progress(message="go")
        progress(message="go")

    _run(handler_filesize(file=path, enable=True, clear=False, intrusiveness=0), body)
    cleared = _fresh("clear.progress")

    def clear_body():
        progress = progressor(steps=2, on_exit=False)
        progress(message="x")
        progress(message="y")

    _run(handler_filesize(file=cleared, enable=True, clear=True, intrusiveness=0), clear_body)
    zero = _fresh("zero.progress")

    def zero_body():
        progressor(steps=0, on_exit=False)

    _run(handler_filesize(file=zero, enable=True, clear=False, intrusiveness=0), zero_body)
    missing = _fresh("off.progress")

    def off_body():
        progress = progressor(steps=2, on_exit=False)
        progress(message="x")
        progress(message="y")

    _run(handler_filesize(file=missing, enable=False), off_body)
    return {
        "intrusiveness": bare._env["intrusiveness"],
        "target": bare._env["target"],
        "init": box["init"],
        "first": box["first"],
        "zero": box["zero"],
        "interrupt": box["interrupt"],
        "final": _read(path),
        "final_size": os.path.getsize(path),
        "cleared": os.path.exists(cleared),
        "zero_steps": _read(zero),
        "zero_size": os.path.getsize(zero),
        "disabled": os.path.exists(missing),
    }


value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
value["median_ms"] = statistics.median(elapsed)
print(json.dumps(value))

proof.python:
import json
import statistics
import time

from progressr.backends import handler_tkprogressbar
from progressr.evaluate import with_progress
from progressr.options import ProgressrError
from progressr.progressor import progressor


def _open_bar(handler):
    finish = handler._env["reporter"]["initiate"]
    closed = dict(
        zip(finish.__code__.co_freevars, (cell.cell_contents for cell in finish.__closure__))
    )
    box = closed["pb_config"]
    if box[0] is None:
        return None
    return box[0]["pb"]


def state(steps, clear):
    handler = handler_tkprogressbar(clear=clear, enable=True)

    def body():
        progress = progressor(steps=4, on_exit=False)
        for index in range(1, steps + 1):
            progress(message=f"m{index}")

    with_progress(
        body,
        handlers=handler,
        enable=True,
        interval=0,
        delay_terminal=False,
        delay_stdout=False,
        delay_conditions=(),
    )
    pb = _open_bar(handler)
    if pb is None:
        return {"gone": True}
    try:
        snap = pb.snapshot()
    finally:
        pb.kill()
    return {
        "gone": False,
        "title": snap["title"],
        "label": snap["label"],
        "percent": snap["percent"],
        "geometry": snap["geometry"],
    }


def one():
    try:
        handler_tkprogressbar(inputs="x", enable=True)
        bad = ""
    except ProgressrError as exc:
        bad = str(exc)
